route: Tempus Fugit, 2128890027, one lap including lead-in
conditions: Both frames stage 0; no aero socks, no inertia, 100% prescribed power, no optimizer. Identical course geometry and power schedule in all cells.
selection: Three equal route-index intervals. Use median speed at each target among nontrivial (>=0.05 m) segments with absolute reconstructed rise/run <=1e-6 and reference pavement Crr 0.004. Require >=10 samples at each target. No residual-based exclusion.
fit: Fit P=A*v^3+B*v from 150 and 350 W medians, v in m/s. 250 W checks curve shape. No family selection. Predict the fourth curve as Tri+disc plus Canyon+42 minus Canyon+disc, term by term, before submitting that cell.
acceptance: All four individual fits positive A, nonnegative B and <=1 W absolute error at 250 W. Frozen fourth prediction <=1 W maximum absolute error at all three observed speeds. Repeat median speeds within 0.02 km/h at each target. No retuning. This tests flat additivity at these settings only.
stop_rules: Fresh anonymous public UI only. No redirects, retries, optimization or sharing. Stop on HTTP/network, schema/context or unknown write outcome. Archive allowlisted medians/counts and frozen prediction, never raw payloads. Old stopped pilot ledger untouched.
